description: The L_Shape.inp building model is open in eQUEST. This is a real L-shaped commercial building with HVAC zones across four floors (Basement, Ground, Middle, Top) served by Packaged Single Zone (PSZ) systems. Change the design cooling temperature (DESIGN-COOL-T) of zone 'South Perim Zn (BB.S1)', which is the control zone for system 'Sys1 (PSZ) (BB.C1)', from 75°F to 76°F. This is an energy conservation measure to reduce cooling demand. Save the project after making the change.
